protocol.description:
wlrix-desks lets a privileged client -- the IRIX-style "Desks Overview" -- enumerate the compositor's desks (virtual desktops) and the windows on them, receive live window geometry, and drive desk and window management: create/rename/delete/activate desks, and minimize/restore/maximize/raise/lower/move windows.
A reserved "global" desk holds windows that appear on every desk; it cannot be removed or deactivated.
This is a wlRIX-specific protocol, not a standard: it carries live window geometry, which the Overview draws as opaque rectangles and no standard protocol provides.

interface.name: wlrix_desks_manager_v1

description.summary: enumerate and manage desks and windows

interface.description: The manager is the entry point. On bind the compositor advertises every desk (a wlrix_desk_v1) and every window (a wlrix_toplevel_v1), each followed by its property events, and closes the burst with a done event. Thereafter, it announces new desks and windows the same way and emits property changes on the existing objects, each batch ended by done.

request.name: create_desk
request.description: Ask the compositor to create a new ordinary desk. The compositor chooses its name and announces it with a desk event followed by done. The desk is not activated.

request.name: stop
request.description: The client is no longer interested. The compositor sends finished once it has stopped sending events, after which the client should destroy the manager. Existing desk and toplevel objects remain valid until individually removed/closed or the manager is destroyed.

event.name: desk
event.description: Introduces a desk. The compositor immediately follows this with the desk's property events (name, and global for the global desk) and, when it is the active desk, an activated event.

event.name: toplevel
event.description: Introduces a window. The compositor immediately follows this with the window's property events (app_id, title, geometry, state, desk).

event.name: done
event.description: All events since the previous done form one atomic update. A client should not act on a half-applied batch.

event.name: finished
event.description: Sent in response to stop. No further events will be sent on the manager; the client should destroy it.

interface.name: wlrix_desk_v1
interface.description: One desk. Property events (id, name, global, activated/deactivated) arrive after the manager's desk event and whenever they change, each batch ended by the manager's done.

event.name: id
event.description: A small integer that is stable for the life of the desk. The global desk is always 0. Sent once, right after the desk is introduced.

event.name: global
event.description: Sent once, for the global desk only: its windows appear on every desk, and it cannot be removed or deactivated.

description.summary: the desk is no longer active

event.name: removed
event.description: The desk no longer exists. The client should destroy this object; no further events will be sent on it.

request.name: activate
request.description: Make this the active desk. Ignored for the global desk.

request.name: remove
request.description: Delete this desk; its windows move to a neighboring desk. Ignored for the global desk and refused when it is the last ordinary desk (at least one must remain).

request.name: destroy
request.description: Stop receiving events for this desk. Does not delete the desk; use remove for that.

interface.name: wlrix_toplevel_v1
interface.description: One window on some desk. Property events arrive after the manager's toplevel event and whenever they change; geometry in particular is emitted live as the window moves or resizes, each batch ended by the manager's done.

description.summary: window state flags carried by the state event
the window's position and size, in the global layout

event.name: state
event.description: An array of wlrix_toplevel_v1.state values, each a 32-bit little-endian integer. Absent flags are off.

description.summary: the desk this window is on

event.name: closed
event.description: The window no longer exists. The client should destroy this object; no further events will be sent on it.

description.summary: bring to the front and focus
move the window to another desk

request.name: destroy
request.description: Stop receiving events for this window. Does not close the window.
